stem: Which pairing correctly distinguishes the lecture’s numerical array library, plotting library and interactive notebook environment?

options.text: NumPy supplies notebooks, matplotlib supplies arrays, and IPython/Jupyter supplies plots.
NumPy supplies arrays, matplotlib supplies notebooks, and IPython/Jupyter supplies the plotting library.
NumPy supplies arrays, matplotlib supplies plots, and IPython/Jupyter supplies interactive execution and reports.
NumPy supplies plots, matplotlib supplies numerical arrays, and IPython/Jupyter supplies interactive notebooks.

stem: The DataFrame data_pandas has columns Name, Location, Age and rows 0: John, New York, 24; 1: Anna, Paris, 13; 2: Peter, Berlin, 53; 3: Linda, London, 33. The code consistently defines lowercase data_pandas. What is data_pandas.iloc[1, 2], and what if the source table’s uppercase Data_pandas is used with no such name defined?

options.text: The lowercase expression returns Paris; the uppercase expression refers to the same variable.
The lowercase expression returns 53; the uppercase expression returns 13.
Both expressions return the entire second row.
The lowercase expression returns 13; the uppercase expression raises NameError.
